statement: Here we see the difference between planted clique and sparse PCA. In the planted clique problem, if we take a subset of the clique, we can easily recover the whole clique from the output of the spectral algorithm and we do not need to consider other sets after that. In sparse PCA, since we do not know β exactly, it might not be easy to understand if the observed s was correct or not from the output of the spectral algorithm.
